

### Classification of expression quartiles
I want to classify the expression levels of genes into quartiles. 
This will help in understanding the distribution of gene expression across different samples and conditions.
Resulting variable will be a factor indicating the quartile of expression for each gene.
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)
```

```{r}
rpkm_data <- read_tsv("data/landscapes/features/57epigenomes.RPKM.pc.gz")
gene_meta <- read_tsv("data/landscapes/features/Ensembl_v65.Gencode_v10.ENSG.gene_info.txt", #nolint
                      col_names = FALSE)
rpkm_e116 <- rpkm_data |> select(gene_id, E116)
pc_names <- rpkm_data$gene_id

names(gene_meta) <- c("gene_id", "chr", "start", "end", "strand",
                      "gene_type", "gene_name", "gene_descr")

rm(rpkm_data)
```

```{r}
genome_ranges_10kb <- read_csv("data/landscapes/hg19_1Mb_coords.csv")

regions <- GRanges(
  seqnames = genome_ranges_10kb$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = genome_ranges_10kb$start,
                   end = genome_ranges_10kb$end)
)
```
# quartile classification
```{r}
quartiles <- quantile(rpkm_e116$E116,
                      probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                      na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rpkm_e116 <- rpkm_e116 |>
  mutate(expression_quartile = cut(E116,
                                   breaks = quartiles,
                                   labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
                                   include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(expression_quartile = ifelse(E116 == 0, "Q0",
                                      as.character(expression_quartile)))
```

# intergenic regions annotation
```{r}
# get coordinates of the coding genes
coding_genes <- gene_meta |>
  filter(gene_id %in% pc_names) |>
  left_join(rpkm_e116 |> select(gene_id, expression_quartile),
            by = "gene_id")
```

```{r}
coding_ranges <- GRanges(
  seqnames = paste0("chr", coding_genes$chr),
  ranges = IRanges(start = coding_genes$start,
                   end = coding_genes$end)
)
```

```{r}
# find intergenic regions by subtracting coding gene ranges
# from the genome ranges
genomic_overlaps <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(regions, coding_ranges)
overlapping_region_indices <- unique(queryHits(genomic_overlaps))
intergenic_ranges <- regions[!seq_along(regions) %in%
                               overlapping_region_indices]
```

```{r}
expression_quartile_table <- tibble(chr = genome_ranges_10kb$chr,
                                    start = genome_ranges_10kb$start,
                                    end = genome_ranges_10kb$end,
                                    expression_quartile = NA_character_,
                                    kb_id = genome_ranges_10kb$kb_id)
```

```{r}
expression_quartile_table$expression_quartile[
  !seq_along(regions) %in% overlapping_region_indices
] <- "intergenic"
```

```{r}
genomic_overlaps_tibble <- as_tibble(genomic_overlaps) |>
  distinct(queryHits, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(expression_quartile = coding_genes$expression_quartile[subjectHits])
```

```{r}
expression_quartile_table$expression_quartile[
  genomic_overlaps_tibble$queryHits
] <- genomic_overlaps_tibble$expression_quartile
```

```{r}
write.csv(expression_quartile_table,
          "data/landscapes/features/expression_quartiles.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gene_meta |> count(gene_type, sort = TRUE)
```

### Non-protein coding genes
```{r}
rpkm_nc <- read_tsv("data/landscapes/features/57epigenomes.RPKM.nc.gz") |>
  select(gene_id, E116)
```

```{r}
nc_names <- rpkm_nc$gene_id
gene_meta |>
  filter(gene_id %in% nc_names) |>
  left_join(rpkm_nc, by = "gene_id")
```
